{{Quote|Awfully quiet... But the ''Force'' tells me I'm not alone, so&mdash;|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Blind Jedi's Bluff" />}}
This '''unidentified planet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went on a mission to this planet, thinking he would find a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] traitor with information to sell. The mission was actually a trap set up by six [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who [[Assassination attempt on Obi-Wan Kenobi|attempted]] to assassinate Kenobi, as a means of gaining admission to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="Blind Jedi's Bluff" />
